content.title: About
content.content: Soy milk is a plant‑based beverage made from soybeans that are ground, cooked, and filtered. The sweetened version contains added sugar but no artificial flavors or colors. Refrigerated soy milk is kept cold and typically lasts 7‑10 days after opening.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Commercial soy milk production began in the United States in the 1930s.
Sweetened varieties often use cane or corn syrup to achieve their flavor.
Soy milk provides all nine essential amino acids, making it a complete protein source among plant drinks.
Unlike cow's milk, soy milk is naturally lactose‑free, suitable for those with lactose intolerance.
Refrigerated soy drinks are frequently fortified with calcium, vitamin D, and vitamin B12 to match the nutritional profile of dairy milk.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: A 240 ml serving provides about 7 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance and satiety.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Soy milk contains mostly polyunsaturated fats, which can help improve cholesterol levels.

items.title: Source of isoflavones
items.content: Isoflavones are phyto‑compounds that may support hormonal balance and cardiovascular health.

items.title: Fortified with calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Most brands add calcium and vitamin D to promote bone health.

items.title: Vegan‑friendly
items.content: Contains no animal ingredients, making it suitable for vegans and vegetarians.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to soy proteins, ranging from skin rashes to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Added sugar content
items.content: Sweetened soy milk can contain significant amounts of sugar, which is a concern for diabetics or those limiting calories.

items.title: Phytic acid
items.content: Soy contains phytic acid, which can reduce the absorption of certain minerals when consumed in large amounts.

items.title: GMO presence
items.content: Most soybeans grown worldwide are genetically modified; choose non‑GMO labeled products if preferred.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Soy milk can be drunk straight, added to smoothies, oatmeal, coffee, baked goods, and sauces. The sweetened version pairs well with cereals and desserts. Shake the container before use to recombine any settled solids.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1‑4 °C. After opening, consume within 7‑10 days. Do not leave the opened product at room temperature for more than 2 hours. Discard if the taste, smell, or texture changes.
